title: Dental PPO Plans Enrollment Records per Person and Coverage Tier
content:
**Rule.** Under the Dental PPO Plans a subscriber may hold several dental PPO enrollments, one for each person covered under the subscriber's coverage tier (the subscriber and each enrolled spouse, domestic partner or child), so there is no fixed cap per subscriber. A person may not have a second applied or active Cascade dental PPO enrollment while one is already applied or active.

**Same plan and tier on one billing account.** Every enrollment of the same subscriber funded by the same billing account carries the same plan and the same coverage tier, and the persons enrolled must fit that tier:

| Coverage tier | Persons covered |
|---|---|
| Member only | The subscriber alone |
| Member and spouse | The subscriber and one spouse or domestic partner |
| Member and children | The subscriber and one or more children |
| Family | The subscriber, one spouse or domestic partner, and one or more children |

**Identifying a person.** A person is identified by the enrollee name together with the enrollee date of birth. A cancelled or terminated enrollment of the same person does not block a new one, except as the re-enrollment lockout of the Dental PPO enrollment eligibility rules provides.

### Points of judgement
- The one-open-enrollment test is read from the system's enrollment records for the same name and date of birth: an enrollment in applied or active status blocks a second one; a cancelled or terminated one does not.
- Hypothetical: a subscriber on the member-and-children tier with three enrolled children holds four enrollments on the same billing account, all on the same plan and tier.
